faq: What does a startup analytics stack actually need?
Two things: one product analytics tool and one warehouse. Everything beyond that is a want, and most of it duplicates something you already pay for.
Why do analytics stacks end up costing $5k a month?
Overlapping tools nobody consolidated, seats assigned to people who never log in, and event volume nobody has pruned since the tracking plan was written.
Can you really run analytics for $100 a month?
For most early-stage products, yes. The free and startup tiers of the major tools cover more than founders expect, and the warehouse cost at low volume is small.
When a specific question you need answered is genuinely blocked by the tooling — not when a vendor tells you you've outgrown it.
